decisions.reason: As a large German door-systems producer, the firm is likely to persist with this core industrial door offering because it fits its announced customer-near development path, uses existing manufacturing capabilities, and disappointing signals can still be read as temporary rather than decisive.

Management is especially likely to retain this insulated glazed industrial door because it matches the firm's compliance, thermal and customized-systems positioning, making prior investment and public commitment harder to reverse.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door received its own product page and sits close to the firm's established industrial access business, escalation of commitment makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.
